decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate was presented as a flagship for a clear agricultural niche, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises some risk that it is being phased out.
Stackable crates are a low-cost staple for food, retail and pooling customers, but the line has not appeared on the website recently and the firm has shown it will prune overlapping lines.
The medium-duty rackable pallet fills a standard gap in the range, yet its disappearance from the website and the earlier pruning of other pallet lines make withdrawal a real possibility.
